messages:
Anna Park: quick one — posted a couple layout options for the billing dashboard in the figma link. thinking about grid cards (more visual) vs compact list (dense info). curious about invoice CTA placement and where the token breakdown should live per org vs project view. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/billing-layouts
Miguel Santos: saw it, thanks. my gut: grid for overview page, list for drilldown. grids help surface anomalies visually.
Jaspreet Kaur: agree with @Miguel — but concerned about vertical space for mobile. grids can become cramped.
Rachel Li: +1 to split: overview = grid, detailed = list. also we need a clear affordance for "download invoice" — users expect it top-right of invoice row/card.
Sam Ortiz: nit: if we put token breakdown on the right rail it becomes hidden on smaller screens. maybe inline accordion per card?
Lee Chen: data question — if we show token breakdown in-card, it bloats the card for org view (lots of projects). maybe show a compact sparkline + token denom in card, expand on click to full breakdown.
Anna Park: good call. proposal: cards show sparkline + total tokens + top 1 cost driver. clicking opens an inline drawer with full token table + invoice CTA. list view shows invoice rows with a per-row kebab for download and a compact token popover.
Jaspreet Kaur: UX copy: instead of "Download" use "Download invoice (CSV)" or "PDF" depending on file type. be explicit.
Rachel Li: accessibility: buttons need aria-labels, and the expansion control must be keyboard-focusable and announce open/closed state.
accessibility-bot: automated check — expansion control: ensure aria-expanded present; download links: provide descriptive link text; color contrast: sparkline alt color fails AA on dark theme.
Sam Ortiz: thanks bot. for dark theme we can tweak the accent color to #7FC7FF — that should pass contrast.
Miguel Santos: performance: if we render token tables for all cards on the overview we'll OOM for orgs with 200 projects. lazy-load on open.
Lee Chen: agree. also cache token breakdowns per project for 10m to avoid repeated queries when toggling.
Anna Park: sounds like consensus. action items: 1) Rafael/Frontend to prototype card-expanded drawer with lazy-load (Sam/Lee?) 2) @Jaspreet to update copy for CTAs and downloads 3) @Rachel to add a11y checklist to the comp 4) Design to validate mobile stacked list fallback.
Sam Ortiz: I can take the prototype, will do a quick perf test with a 200-project org mock.
Jaspreet Kaur: I'll send copy PR by EOD Thursday.
Rachel Li: I'll add a11y checklist to the figma file and ping accessibility leads.
Anna Park: awesome — small follow-up: can we try the grid with denser typography (compact tokens) and compare with list in the next sync? pairing session Friday?
Miguel Santos: Friday works for me.
Lee Chen: same.
Anna Park: thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
